title: 'Sign in to <cloud> again' (ConnectCloudButton) may unmount mid sign-in if the scene goes inactive then active (foreground → openStarted → .connecting hides the row); fix with the screen-held authenticate pattern from PR 1370 once a device run confirms the hazard.
evidence: ios/HealthRoadmap/Sync/ConnectCloudButton.swift reads webAuthenticationSession in the row; ios/HealthRoadmap/App/HealthRoadmapApp.swift follow(.active) calls sync.foreground(); SyncView shows the row only at a .signIn problem, the welcome sheet only at failed. Found in review of PR 1370 (US-25 AC11n, R1)
